Name: Nikki and Love EN translation
Author: interumoon
Description:
This is a translation for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36944]Nikki and Love[/url] mod made by the talented [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LongOnly/mods?gameId=1303]LongOnly[/url]! This is a dependant mod so you have to download the original first before downloading the translation.

To install, simply unzip the file and drag the i18n file into your already downloaded Nikki and Love folder and select for it to replace the existing file if it asks you to. Note that this will delete the original Chinese version of the text — this is my very first translation mod and I do not know how to change the text without replacing it if modded from a foreign language to English so I apologize for that (,,>﹏<,,) You can, in theory, get the original language back by redownloading the mod and having it delete the translation I made but I haven't tested it myself.

Nonetheless ﻿I hope any Infinity NIkki fans will enjoy this translation <3
